veranderings.voor: leidrade oor hoe hulle gelyk en geleef het
veranderings.na: leidrade oor hoe hierdie voorouers gelyk en geleef het
veranderings.rede: In this sentence 'hulle' could refer to the scientists, the nearest plural subject, so naming the ancestors makes the reference clear.
'help ... om te verstaan' is the standard written construction and reads more smoothly for Grade 5.
Afrikaans needs the article in 'oor 'n baie lang tyd'; without it the phrase reads like a translation from English.

vlae.teks: Daarom is dit erfenis van die hele mensdom en nie net van Suid-Afrika nie.
vlae.rede: 'dit' follows a sentence about 'Die fossiele' (plural), so it is unclear whether the fossils or the site is meant; it reads acceptably as a general 'dit', but choosing a noun would mean guessing the intent, so this is flagged and not changed.
